record.question: Which public sector bank has become the first bank in the country that has linked its deposit accounts and short term loans to an external benchmark?
record.explanation: Answer A: State Bank of India. SBI first linked its deposit and short-term loan rates to an external benchmark in 2019. Reference: https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=11603. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
